title: Turn a Chart Into an Animation With Claude Motion

viewer.problem: Turning static charts into animated explainers takes time
viewer.job: Make and refine an editable animation from a prompt

idea: Turn a chart into a coded motion explainer with Claude Motion.

claims.text: Claude Motion builds code-based animations from prompts and supports MP4 export; beta for Team and Enterprise.

proof_plan.how_shown: Original animated illustrative reconstruction using sample data; not a screen recording.

scenes.say: Turn a boring chart into a moving explainer, just by asking.
scenes.heading: FROM CHART TO STORY

scenes.say: In Claude, choose Output, then Motion. Type: animate my sales chart, with each bar growing in sequence.
scenes.heading: ASK FOR MOTION

scenes.say: Claude writes code that moves your graphics. Watch the bars rise, the labels appear, and the takeaway land.
scenes.heading: WATCH IT BUILD

scenes.say: Need a change? Ask Claude to highlight the last bar in coral. The color changes while the rest stays put.
scenes.heading: EDIT ONE DETAIL

scenes.say: Then export your animation as an MP4. Motion is in beta for Team and Enterprise; Enterprise owners may need to enable it.
scenes.heading: EXPORT YOUR MP4

scenes.say: Want the guide? Comment MOTION and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

review.notes: Owner requested schedule and confirmed full audiovisual outro review. Illustrative reconstruction, sample data, AI voice and synthetic cover.

youtube.title: Turn a Chart Into an Animation With Claude Motion
youtube.description:
Claude Motion turns a chart into an editable animated explainer. Choose Output, select Motion, describe the animation, ask for a revision, and export an MP4.

This video is an illustrative reconstruction using sample data, not a screen recording of Claude. Claude Motion is a beta for Team and Enterprise; an Enterprise owner may need to enable it. Review your source data and output before publishing.

Official Claude Motion guide: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/17454997-get-started-with-claude-motion

Original animated illustration and synthetic cover. AI-generated narration.
